workload.warmup: one full pp then independent tg, all phases reset outside timer

limitations: Reference uses native CPU_REPACK and quantized activations; llmx IQ4 keeps original F32 activations. This compares runtime policies, not equivalent arithmetic.

Both logical context capacities follow model metadata, but backing/allocation designs differ. Loading is outside timing; actual placement/repack/context witnesses must be inspected in retained stderr.
Small differences require assessment against owner-matched layout perturbation before attribution; no such control has run.
Native focused tests and earlier HF results do not constitute final exact-head release gates.
Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.
All calls and observations retained, including failed or incomplete calls. Activity flags are not automatic rejection rules.
Small changes remain inconclusive as isolated optimization effects without a matched owner-site layout control.
Observed docker clients require parent identity and start time. Short-lived or reparented unseen clients remain unknown; other docker processes are not excluded.
Whole-call rusage and cgroup counters include loading, warmup, prompt and decode without phase attribution.
CPU role means use overlapping interval portions; missing process deltas are not zero measured work.
Adjacent calls may share bracket observations. Disk rates are per whole device; GPU counters have no process attribution.
This Linux screen is separate from the Windows six-thread screen; their rates do not subtract across environments.

decision.integration: Initial CPU support retains scalar registry prompt expansion; SIMD experiment is excluded and its branch remains intact.
decision.reason: Linux prefill directions are modest without an owner-matched layout control, Windows is mixed, and reverse 0.6B decode attribution is unresolved. This is not proof of a regression or rejection by an isolated loss threshold.
decision.quality_proposal: Unapproved; no acceptance bound is changed.
decision.release: Final CPU gates and exact-head CI remain pending.
decision.recovery: Profile fused CPU IQ4 lookup/float-product/reduction and prompt tile instruction/load/register costs against the actual repacked mx path. Measure the smallest exact-arithmetic variant before broader HF checks; preserve current precision, finite-range handling and all unfavorable results.

environment.clock_policy: No clock override; actual clocks were not captured.

asset_8b.scope: Speed only; no independent 8B IQ4 HF/quality qualification or hosted fixture registration.

interpretation: Both prefill settings have opposite paired signs. This Windows screen does not establish a reliable model prefill gain.
The tg128 guardrail improves in both pairs, while tg32 has opposite signs. Preserved decode instructions do not establish why rates differ.
Every call flags unrelated CPU use and unknown process deltas; zero flagged disk/GPU thresholds and zero unavailable counter samples do not mean an idle machine.
No matched owner-site layout control or mx call was measured; no isolated kernel-effect or reference-parity claim is made.
